answer: The Bank-verified account bound by challenge-response signature with revocation on transfer makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the bank-verified account answers a fresh challenge, the challenge-response signature is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Even a quiet ledge gets heard, because binding weighs evidence, not volume. A beacon and a atlas may look alike, but only the identity with a verified channel is honoured.
